a2-imperfectobasico-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Summers by the Lake
a2-imperfectobasico-01.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Meg asks what you used to do when you were little. You grew up near a lake.
a2-imperfectobasico-01.prompt: Tell Meg what you always did as a child.
cues: Say what you normally did with friends
a2-imperfectobasico-01.target: De niño, siempre nadaba en el lago. Normalmente jugaba con mis amigos.
a2-imperfectobasico-01.english: As a child, I always swam in the lake. I normally played with my friends.
a2-imperfectobasico-01.canDo: I can form the imperfecto of regular -AR verbs.

a2-imperfectobasico-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Did You Live?
a2-imperfectobasico-02.scenario: At the café in Hanoi, Daniela asks where you lived and what you ate when you were a student.
a2-imperfectobasico-02.prompt: Tell Daniela where you lived and what you ate.
cues: Say what you ate with friends
a2-imperfectobasico-02.target: Vivía en un apartamento pequeño. Comía con mis amigos cada día.
a2-imperfectobasico-02.english: I lived in a small flat. I ate with my friends every day.
a2-imperfectobasico-02.canDo: I can form the imperfecto of regular -ER and -IR verbs.

a2-imperfectobasico-03.title: Communicative Challenge: As a Child
a2-imperfectobasico-03.scenario: Carlos asks you what you were like as a child and where your family went at weekends.
a2-imperfectobasico-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what you were like and where you went.
cues: Say where you went on Saturdays
a2-imperfectobasico-03.target: De niño, era tímido. Los sábados íbamos al parque.
a2-imperfectobasico-03.english: As a child, I was shy. On Saturdays we went to the park.
a2-imperfectobasico-03.canDo: I can conjugate the three irregular imperfecto verbs: ser, ir, ver.

a2-imperfectobasico-04.title: Communicative Challenge: My Childhood Home
a2-imperfectobasico-04.scenario: At the language exchange, Meg asks what the house of your childhood was like.
a2-imperfectobasico-04.prompt: Describe your childhood house to Meg.
cues: Say what the house was like
Say what the weather was like
a2-imperfectobasico-04.target: Mi casa era pequeña pero acogedora. Hacía mucho frío y llovía.
a2-imperfectobasico-04.english: My house was small but cosy. It was very cold and it rained.
a2-imperfectobasico-04.canDo: I can use the imperfecto to describe past physical states, emotions, and appearances.

a2-imperfectobasico-05.title: Communicative Challenge: My Grandmother
a2-imperfectobasico-05.scenario: At the café in Hanoi, Daniela asks about your grandmother when you were a child.
a2-imperfectobasico-05.prompt: Tell Daniela about your grandmother and what you did while she cooked.
cues: Say what you did while she cooked
a2-imperfectobasico-05.target: Mi abuela era muy cariñosa y siempre traía un pastel. Mientras ella cocinaba, yo jugaba.
a2-imperfectobasico-05.english: My grandmother was very affectionate and always brought a cake. While she cooked, I played.
a2-imperfectobasico-05.canDo: I can use all imperfecto forms fluently across -AR, -ER, -IR verbs and the three irregulars.

a2-imperfectobasico-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Sundays in the Past
a2-imperfectobasico-consolidation.scenario: Meg asks you to tell her about the Sundays of your childhood.
a2-imperfectobasico-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what your family did on Sundays.
cues: Say what your grandmother did while you played
a2-imperfectobasico-consolidation.target: De niño, los domingos íbamos a casa de mi abuela. Mientras ella hacía la comida, nosotros jugábamos.
a2-imperfectobasico-consolidation.english: As a child, on Sundays we went to my grandmother's house. While she made the food, we played.
a2-imperfectobasico-consolidation.canDo: I can demonstrate command of all imperfecto forms: -AR (-aba), -ER/-IR (-ía), ser/ir/ver.
